mapping.rule: Reuse checked identity/dimensions/hash only after equality with selected A current originals. New A envelope/run_id/producer/input_refs/hash are produced explicitly; B input_refs omit revision/kind and cannot be copied as C01 ArtifactRef.

A supplies reviewed one-question scope, current directory and separate resource/viewer/source/save-page evidence. B reading_order is not a platform page number or directory. No chapter completeness claim.

Preserve immutable B IDs in evidence references; derive distinct A IDs bound to source+B output+conversion version. B bbox is original-image coordinates for its own declared input asset. Require finite positive bounds and exact image binding.

Convert translation/scale/rotation/padding and processed dimensions only from the actual recorded transform. Baseline column crops are translations; never add the offset to its already-original region bbox again. If manual question crops are model inputs, compose that transform back to the A original, preserving manual provenance and exact crop bytes.

unknown is not an A ContentType. For this text-only pilot, classify each selected source region explicitly as text; OCR-derived text uses source=OCR and remains UNCERTAIN until content review. Human edits remain separate revisions/provenance. role_candidate/text_hint/confidence cannot establish confirmed role/text or ordinary single-choice.

mapping.A: Observed EvidenceRecord resources, CoverageClue records and CheckReport issues
mapping.rule: Retain raw lines and geometry; distinguish SHARED_RECOGNITION from independent review. Baseline coverage_evidence explicitly says can_authorize_quality_pass=false. Do not promote its line list to independent whole-page completeness.

mapping.B: selected raw OCR regions/atoms and explicit reviewed grouping
mapping.A: six Fragment records and six final Region records: stem, option A, B, C, D, answer; content_type=text; unique reading_order
mapping.rule: For this A24 pilot exactly one projected region per fragment is necessary. Multiple OCR atoms may support a derived final region/text only with explicit grouping, source references and approved extent; union-by-proximity is not content completeness evidence. Keep unselected raw outputs.

mapping.A: Question{question_id,directory_id,question_type=ordinary_choice,fragment_ids,parent_question_id=null,shared_fragment_ids=[],cross_page=false,external_refs}; GraphPayload source/evidence refs, fragments, answer_relations, identity_notes
mapping.rule: A must construct this layer; baseline alone supplies none. question_id is a stable internal ID, not printed number. New target external platform_question_id/platform_order remain null. Compute cross_page from non-answer/non-explanation source pages; an answer on viewer173 does not itself make question.cross_page=true.

mapping.B: answer-page OCR observation and explicit association evidence
mapping.A: one AnswerRelation with candidate_fragment_ids, selected_fragment_ids=[answer fragment], status=SELECTED, evidence_refs
mapping.rule: Do not select by matching printed 1 alone or mathematical answer guessing. Require section/question/source-pixel identity and answer OCR content review. Missing/conflicting association remains AMBIGUOUS or UNRESOLVED and HOLD.

mapping.A: A current policy maps stem/option/answer to Q/W/A with SEPARATE options; source-bound single-choice qualification and approval content digest
mapping.rule: A admission requires six semantic roles, Q/W/W/W/W/A, explicit A-D option labels, answer text equal to one label, and reviewed SINGLE_CHOICE resource bound to frames/parts. Do not manufacture these confirmations from type labels.

Missing option/text/type/answer/source/crop/coverage/identity enters HOLD. Never translate NOT_EVALUATED or model confidence into PASS. Model test can record partial evidence while fixed-content first-save continues separately.

minimum_graph_shape.source_and_graph_refs: Exact artifact_id/revision/kind/content_hash tuples; graph and evidence source versions must equal.
minimum_graph_shape.answer_relation: Exactly one selected relation, selecting the separate answer fragment; selection evidence is mandatory.
minimum_graph_shape.A_owned_mapping: Book46007447/current leaf; platform tail insertion/actual ID and order/six object crops/body preservation are outside model inference and remain under A24 plan/approval.

cannot_infer_automatically: B UNKNOWN content_type to text; role_candidate to confirmed stem/option/answer; confidence to correctness.
Four candidate boxes imply four complete ordered A-D options, or ordinary_choice implies exactly one correct answer.
A final question boundary is the union of detected OCR boxes; any absent pixel/text can be guessed or discarded.
Printed question 1 and answer 1.C are the same section/book question without source association evidence.
Image list reading_order or resource index equals viewer/source/save-page; page14/resource13 and page173/resource172 retain distinct semantics.
B region UUID remains patch-compatible after source/model/config/dependency changes.
Shared recognizer line coverage proves independent completeness; ignored raw outputs are decoration.
Manual OCR input crops, selected labels, corrections or answer pairing count as autonomous model output.
Static schema conversion, local evidence PASS or immutable hashes authorize model calls/platform save.
